workshop-os-12.8.0.label: Workshop OS 12.8.0 — recommended
workshop-os-12.8.0.description: Current Workshop OS: the display connects to Pi Hub and takes its updates from the Pi, idle Home shows the house, printer and timer on one screen, and the Premium UI v2 look (AMS spool gauges, thermal capsules, the Figtree boot splash, normal-case labels). The display camera is not in this image: X2D bridge viewing needs the separate camera build. The OTA image is the exact CI build that passed unattended acceptance on the WS350 (2 Nov 2026); the Full image wraps the same application for a fresh USB install.
